fusions.name: First Drop
fusions.desc: A bead of water that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to leave it [Soaked] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Squall Line
fusions.desc: After a 0.6 second gather, looses 5 sheets of rain in a fan, each dealing 12 water damage that ignores resistances and rises 10% per affliction on the target (max 30%).

fusions.name: Grey Cover
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 5 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, and each veil breaks the moment its bearer attacks.

fusions.name: Runoff
fusions.desc: When a condition you laid on an enemy runs out, you regain 6 mana. Once every 4 seconds.
